package_metadata.purpose: Twenty-one distinct JavaScript code review workflows with tests/checks and human-review triggers.

code_review_workflows.goal: Classify a file before making claims or edits.
code_review_workflows.best_fit_context: First pass over any JS/JSX/MJS/CJS/Apps Script/HTML script file.
preconditions: File contents and path are available
Any package/build/test context is available or explicitly missing
inspection_steps: Identify runtime candidates from imports/globals/file path
Identify module system and top-level side effects
Mark host APIs and current-verification needs
Scan for high-risk constructs: coercion, nullish access, mutation, this, async, JSON/date/regex
safe_outputs: Explicit unknowns needing docs or human context
dangerous_outputs: Assuming runtime from extension alone
Rewriting before classifying host APIs
completion_criteria: Runtime and module system are named or marked verification-required
Primary risks are listed with evidence
failure_modes: Misses file role
Conflates browser Node and Apps Script

code_review_workflows.goal: Find coercion paths that affect comparisons, arithmetic, string output, truthiness, and JSON.
code_review_workflows.best_fit_context: Code handling external inputs, comparisons, filters, totals, form/query/CSV data.
preconditions: Inputs and expected types are known or inferable
inspection_steps: Mark every boundary where strings/nullish values enter
Search operators == != < > <= >= + if && || ?? template literals JSON.stringify
safe_outputs: Specific coercion findings with input examples
dangerous_outputs: Generic advice to avoid coercion without naming operators/values
tests_or_checks: Tests for "", "0", "10", 0, false, null, undefined, NaN, object operands
completion_criteria: Every conversion-sensitive operator near external input is reviewed
failure_modes: Misses + string concatenation or relational conversion

code_review_workflows.goal: Prevent TypeError and hidden missing-data bugs.
code_review_workflows.best_fit_context: Nested property access, DOM query results, API responses, optional chaining refactors.
preconditions: Known object shape or API contract if possible
inspection_steps: List nested access chains and destructuring sites
Decide required invariant versus optional absence
Add tests for missing parent and valid falsy child
safe_outputs: Optional chaining only where absence is accepted
dangerous_outputs: Blanket optional chaining that hides required data
tests_or_checks: Missing parent, null child, undefined property, 0/""/false values
completion_criteria: Every crash-prone access has explicit absence policy
failure_modes: Optional chaining used as error suppression

code_review_workflows.workflow_name: Review Apps Script code as extension
code_review_workflows.goal: Review Apps Script without pretending it is browser or Node JavaScript.

preconditions: Project files or snippets available

List Apps Script services, triggers, scopes, quotas, deployment behavior to verify
Check SpreadsheetApp read/write safety and idempotence
safe_outputs: Apps Script-specific review with current-doc flags
dangerous_outputs: Inventing current Apps Script behavior
Using Node/browser fixes in server .gs
tests_or_checks: Small Apps Script probe where docs leave ambiguity
completion_criteria: Every Apps Script claim is marked current-verification or docs-backed by downstream work
failure_modes: Conflates HtmlService browser code with server .gs

code_review_workflows.goal: Plan a behavior-preserving change around JavaScript-specific risks.

completion_criteria: Each changed semantic has evidence of preserved or intentionally changed behavior

code_review_workflows.goal: Design a compact test set that targets actual JavaScript risks.
code_review_workflows.best_fit_context: Bug reports, code review findings, or refactor requests.
preconditions: Risk list or code snippet available
inspection_steps: Pick one happy path and one edge/failure path per relevant risk
Include async rejection and ordering when async exists
Include runtime smoke test when host boundary exists
Include JSON/date/regex edge cases where data crosses boundaries
safe_outputs: Minimal targeted test list with inputs and expected outcomes
dangerous_outputs: Huge generic test suite proposal not tied to risk
tests_or_checks: Run in target runtime or mark missing
completion_criteria: Every identified high risk has at least one evidence check
failure_modes: Tests ignore failure paths
